Commentary.Commentary: 1650 local time - We will have a 33-over game with the target for Australia being 235. Australia will feel good about this or will they think it is unfair on them? On the updated rules - Three bowlers can bowl seven overs, while two bowlers can bowl six. On the field restrictions, Powerplay 1 (1-7), Powerplay 2 (8-27), Powerplay 3 (28-33).
1647 local time - The rain has stopped and the covers are coming off. Cricket Australia have tweeted that "Play will resume at 1715 local time if there is no further rain. Revised target to come."
1630 local time - The rain hasn't relented yet. The next update will be at 1730 local time. Stay tuned...
Oh dear! Just as we write that, it has started to rain. So hope that it clears out soon and we can resume with the chase as early as possible. Fingers crossed.

Williamson fell just after getting to his first ODI ton against Australia. They were going well as the Aussie bowlers struggled to keep the scoring down. Wickets fell in a heap towards the end and the Kiwis lost the plot completely. Steven Smith will be happy with the way they have roared back in the game and will bank on his batting line-up to come good. Their bowling was far from ideal today until Hazlewood stepped up to register his best figures in ODIs. Despite the collapse, the Black Caps will hope that their bowling steps up for them. As of now, Australia look set to maintain their unbeaten record in Champions Trophy against New Zealand. Join us in a while for the chase.

What an effort from Australia! They have come back superbly taking 7 for 37 to bowl out the Kiwis. The fact that there was still an over to go just puts the collapse in perspective. Josh Hazlewood was the star for them, taking his third five-wicket haul in ODIs. They will be really pleased with their efforts as New Zealand had got off to a good start with a 99-run stand between Kane Williamson and Ross Taylor steadying them.

OUT! Hazlewood gets his sixth! Good length delivery around off, Boult tries to poke at it. Gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies towards the keeper. Wade makes no mistake and Hazlewood ends with career-best figures of 9-0-52-6. NEW ZEALAND ARE BUNDLED OUT FOR 291!
Good length delivery outside off, Boult tries to feel at it but he fails to make contact.
Trent Boult comes out to bat to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Brilliant catch, skipper! Fuller delivery outside off, Santner drives it uppishly towards the extra-cover region. Smith leaps to his left and takes a sensational catch. Hazlewood gets his 3rd ODI fifer in the process. Santner has to walk back to the hut. Hat-trick ball is coming up..
Tim Southee walks out next.

OUT! Milne cannot find the gap this time! He instead finds the fielder. Short delivery into the batsman, Milne pulls it powerfully but straight towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Maxwell hops a bit and takes a fine catch to send Milne back who was looking dangerous.
FOUR! Milne makes the bad ball vanish! Short delivery into the body, Milne pulls it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Low full toss outside off, Santner goes way across and drives it towards long off of the toe end for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Santner drives it towards mid off for a single to keep strike.
Wide! Way down the leg side this time, Santner tries to tickle it fine but fails to make contact. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Full toss outside off, Milne drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Another full toss outside off, Santner pushes it towards mid off for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Milne lofts it towards the long off fielder for a single.
Another full toss outside off, Santner punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Darts a full toss down the leg side, Santner gets bat on it and guides that really fine through the fine leg region for a boundary.
Mitchell Starc is back for a bowl.
Leg bye! Good length delivery into the pads, Santner fails to clip it fine. Gets rapped on the pads and the batsmen run across for a leg bye as the ball goes towards square leg.
Angling into the batsman, Milne shuffles a bit and clips it towards backward square leg for a single.
Shorter length delivery outside off, Milne tries to flay at it but fails to make contact.
FOUR! What-a-way to get off the mark! Fuller delivery around off, Milne drives it powerfully through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Adam Milne is the next man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Fuller delivery outside off, Neesham swings his bat at it. Gets no timing on it and the ball flies towards the fielder at long on. David Warner gets under it and takes a fine catch. Neesham's struggle in the middle comes to an end and the Black Caps sink further.
Fuller delivery outside off, Neesham throws his bat at it. Slices it over the backward point region for a couple.
Short delivery into the body, Neesham clips it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Mitchell Santner comes in to bat.

OUT! Cummins strikes again! Angling in from a fuller length around off, Corey Anderson tries making room for himself and looks to go for another biggie. He does not connect well and the ball balloons towards the backward point region. Henriques back paddles and takes a fine catch to send Corey Anderson back to the hut. The Kiwis are losing the plot here.
SIX! Top edged! Another short delivery around off this time. Corey Anderson goes for the pull, gets a top edge on it and the ball flies over the fine leg region for half a dozen.
Short delivery into the body, Anderson sways away from the line of the delivery and ends up finding himself on the floor.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Neesham flicks it through the backward square leg region for a single.
Fires this one down the leg side, Neesham fails to clip it fine. The ball kisses the pads before going to the keeper.
A bit wide outside off, Anderson punches it past the diving point fielder for a couple. An excellent over from Hazlewood comes to an end.
Good length delivery around off, Corey Anderson defends it towards the fielder at point.
Neesham drives it off the bottom half towards wide mid off for a single.

That's a peach! Length delivery and angling away, Neesham tries to defend it but fails to pick the line of the delivery. The ball whizzes past the outside edge and goes straight to the keeper. Wade too is taken aback by the movement on that one and takes it on his second attempt.
Slower delivery and angling away, Neesham gets behind it and defends it neatly.
Corey Anderson walks out to bat.

OUT! Hazlewood strikes rightaway! Fuller delivery in the line of the stumps, Broom takes his front leg out of the way and goes for the slog. Gets the elevation on it but fails to get the distance as the ball flies towards the deep mid-wicket region. Glenn Maxwell in the deep gets under it and takes a fine catch. The Kiwis have lost a couple of quick wickets now.
Josh Hazlewood is called in for a bowl.
Fuller delivery around off, Broom drives it through the cover-region for a single to keep strike.
Broom drives it straight to the fielder at mid on.

BRUTE! Beautiful stuff from Cummins! Another short delivery and this one bounces more the batsman. Neesham looks to defend rising in his crease but just manages to evade it and the batsmen run a single. That was special from Cummins.
Short delivery into the body, Neesham ducks under it.
Broom clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Jimmy Neesham is the new man in. Surprised that Corey Anderson has not come out to bat with his big-hitting ability.

OUT! Williamson departs! Very full outside off, Williamson throws his bat at it and gets it straight to the fielder at point. Moises Henriques the fielder there, throws it quickly back to the bowler. Cummins collects it well and throws it back on the stumps. Williamson is struggling to cover his ground as he did not put in a dive. The umpire goes upstairs to check the run out. Replays show that Williamson was well out of his crease. The Kiwi skipper has to depart just after his ton.
There is a run out appeal at the bowler's end against Williamson. He looks to be a goner here.
Pat Cummins returns for a burst.
Slower delivery outside off, Broom tries to guide it really fine but he fails to make contact.
9th ODI ton for Kane Williamson.

First ODI century against Australia! Williamson pushes it towards mid off for a single. Another superb knock from the Kiwi skipper and he is leading his team from the front. He has been absolutely magnificent for his side.
FOUR! Premeditation works this time! Good length into the stumps, Williamson shuffles across and plays a predetermined paddle scoop over the short fine leg region for a boundary.
Slower delivery full toss outside off, Broom shuffles way across for a paddle towards short fine leg for a single. Starc has a shy at the striker's end but he fails to make contact.

FOUR! Sloppy fielding! Short delivery into the batsman, Broom pulls it over the wide mid-on region. Henriques from long on goes to his right and dives to stop it. The ball goes under him and into the fence.

Good length delivery and angling into the stumps, Broom plays that really fine past the keeper with a dab. Hazlewood makes a fine stop after running to his left from third man. He slips though and the batsmen run a couple.
Fuller delivery around off, Broom drives it through the cover region for a single.
Full toss on the stumps, Williamson clips it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Slower delivery on a length outside off, Williamson dabs it towards the fielder at backward point.
Another steaming yorker right on the stumps, Broom digs it out towards the backward square leg region for a single.
Excellent yorker right on the stumps, Broom digs it out back to the bowler.
Short delivery outside off, Broom tries to play the upper cut but fails to make contact.
Powerplay 3 signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the circle.

SIX! Shot! Another short delivery outside off, Williamson smashes that one over the mid-wicket region for a maximum. Shaun Pollock on air mentions that had Travis Head been at the ropes then he could have had half a chance.
Dug in short down the leg side, Williamson ducks under it. Luckily, the umpire does not single it as a wide.
FOUR! Dragged on! Slower delivery on a shorter length, following the batsman down the leg side. Williamson just sits low and pulls it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Fuller delivery around off, Broom carves it through the backward point region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Williamson dabs it towards third man for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Williamson pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a couple. This also is his highest ODI score against Australia.
Change of ends for John Hastings.
Low full toss on the stumps, Williamson defends it towards the fielder at mid-wicket and calls for a single. Warner has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses it.
Yorker right on the money, Broom blocks it out towards the backward point region. They scamper across for a single as Maxwell has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Fuller delivery outside off, Williamson lofts it over covers for a single. He did not get it off the middle of the bat.
Full toss around off, Broom punches it towards the fielder at mid off for a single.
That was close! Fuller delivery outside off, Broom tries to block it out. Gets beaten by the pace and the ball just whizzes past the off pole.
Fuller delivery outside off, Williamson carves it through the point region. Head goes to his left from sweeper cover and cuts it off. Saves a run for his team.
Change of ends for Mitchell Starc.
Fuller delivery outside off, Broom shuffles a bit and flicks it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket. Brilliant over, just a run from it.
Angling into the hips, Broom works it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Good length delivery angling into the batsman, Broom tries to clip it on the leg side. Ends up getting a leading edge towards the fielder at covers.
Length delivery outside off, Williamson eases it towards long on for a single.
Another good length delivery around off, Williamson dabs it towards the fielder at backward point.
Good length delivery around off, Williamson tries to clip it on the leg side but gets an inside edge which hits him on the box. Ouch.
Moises Henriques is called back for a bowl.
Another slower delivery, fuller around off. Williamson drives it towards long off for a single to keep strike.
Neil Broom is the new man in.

OUT! Taylor holes out! Length delivery around off at a slower pace, Taylor tries to go over mid on for a biggie. Miscues it completely and the ball takes a leading edge and goes towards wide mid off. Henriques from mid off goes to his left and pouches it safely. Ross Taylor has to walk back to the hut. The 99-run stand comes to an end.
Good length delivery outside off, Taylor pushes this one straight to the fielder at covers.
Williamson drags it towards the mid on region for a single.
SIX! Williamson is on the charge! Fuller delivery around off, Williamson swings at it with all his might and gets it over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen.
FOUR! Fantastic! Back of a length delivery outside off, Williamson slaps that over the backward point region for a boundary.
Full length delivery into the pads, Taylor fails to clip it on the leg side and gets rapped on the pads.

FOUR! Fuller delivery into the stumps, Taylor clips it beautifully through the mid-wicket region. Hazlewood gives it a chase from mid on. Tries stopping it with a dive but carries himself into the ropes. The umpire goes upstairs to check and the replays show that Hazlewood's leg was touching the ropes when he made contact with the ball. Boundary signaled.
Short and wide outside off, Taylor cuts it straight towards the point fielder who leaps to make a fine stop.

Leg bye! Slower delivery into the pads, Williamson shuffles across and tries to play the scoop. Misses it completely and the ball goes off his pads towards the short fine leg region. A leg bye is taken.
Change of angle for Starc as he comes around the wicket this time. Back of a length delivery into the body, Williamson defends it towards the fielder at point.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Taylor defends it besides the pitch on the off side for a single. 200 up for New Zealand.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack.
FOUR! Up and over! Another length delivery around off, Williamson shuffles across and lofts this one just over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
Williamson stands tall in his crease and pushes it straight to the fielder at mid-off.

Length delivery outside off, Williamson shuffles way across and tries to play the paddle. Fails to make contact and the ball goes towards the keeper. Wade has a needless shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.

Fuller delivery outside off, Williamson swings his bat at it. Gets it off the inside edge towards the mid-wicket region. Warner has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Henriques who was backing up reacts late which lets the batsmen take the single eventually.
Length delivery outside off, Taylor prods forward and drives it through covers for a single.
John Hastings is called back for a bowl.
Williamson goes leg side and Henriques sees that. Follows him and cramps him for room. Williamson manages to pull it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller delivery outside off, Taylor drives it uppishly towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! Elegant! Good length delivery around off, Taylor shuffles across and uses his wrists to clip it beautifully through the square leg region for a boundary.
Good length delivery into the batsman, Williamson comes down the track and pushes it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Betters it this time! Another short one, this time outside off. Williamson stands deep in his crease and pulls this one brutally over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Short delivery into the batsman, Kane Williamson camps back and pulls it over  square leg region. Head in the deep goes to his right and makes a fine stop to save two runs for his team.
Another good length delivery outside off, Williamson runs it down towards the fielder at third man for a single.
Another good length delivery around off, Williamson defends it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller delivery outside off, Williamson opens the face of the bat and guides it to the fielder at slip.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Taylor slashes hard at it. Gets a bottom edge to it and the ball goes towards the fielder at third man for a single.
Short delivery into the batsman, Ross Taylor ducks under it.
Length delivery into the pads, Ross Taylor looks to clip it but gets an inside edge. A stifled appeal by Cummins is turned down. The replays confirm there was an edge there.
Good length delivery angling into the batsman, Williamson makes room to go big but is cramped for room and has to defend it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Williamson clips it towards the fielder at short mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
A bit short outside off, Ross Taylor mistimes his cut towards the fielder at point.
Good length delivery outside off, Ross Taylor pushes it back to the bowler.
30th ODI fifty for Kane Williamson.
Slower delivery on a shorter length down the leg side, Kane Williamson pulls it towards fine leg for a single. It's been a fine knock from the Kiwi skipper. He needs to carry on the good work.
Change of ends for Moises Henriques!

Time for Drinks! The Kiwis are going well but will know that they will have to up the ante. The Australians for a change, have lacked intensity on the field today. They would look to take wickets and keep the runs down with the rain falling as well.
Very full on the stumps, Taylor digs it out watchfully.
Good length delivery around off, Taylor pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller delivery outside off, Taylor flashes his square drive but finds the fielder at backward point.
Good length delivery outside off, Kane tries to defend it. Gets it off the outer half to third man for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Williamson drives it straight to the fielder at short cover.
Good length delivery outside off, Ross Taylor tries to punch it on the off side. Gets an inside onto his pads and then the ball rolls towards the mid-wicket region. A single taken.
Pat Cummins returns for a bowl.
Quicker delivery outside off, Williamson goes for the cut but he fails to make contact. Stifled appeal turned down.
SIX! Over the ropes! Fuller around off, Kane Williamson gets a bit forward and smacks that over the mid-wicket region for half a dozen.
A short delivery into the pads, Taylor clips it towards square leg for a single.
50-run stand between Taylor and Williamson.
Williamson stands deep in his crease and clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Williamson dances down the track and creams it straight to the fielder at extra cover.
Comes around the wicket and bowls this one outside leg, Williamson comes down the track and clips it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
FOUR! Good shot! Another short delivery into the body, Ross Taylor pulls it beautifully through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, Williamson slaps it towards the fielder at sweeper cover. A single is taken.
Fuller length delivery around off, Ross Taylor mistimes it towards mid on yet picks up a quick single.

Leg bye! Length ball around off, Williamson shuffles a bit and tries to clip it. He fails to make contact and gets rapped high on the pads. The ball goes on the leg side and the batsmen scamper across for a leg bye.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Taylor clips it towards deep square leg for a single.
Angling in from a length outside off, Taylor shuffles a bit and clips it straight towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Drops this one around middle, Ross Taylor comes down the track and drives it towards long on for a single to keep the strike.
Kane camps back and punches it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Fuller into the pads, Kane Williamson kneels down and slog sweeps it over the square leg region for a boundary.
Flatter delivery around off, Williamson pushes it towards the fielder at covers.
Quicker delivery outside off, Williamson makes room to slog but then decides to defend it.
Floated outside off, Taylor comes down the track and eases it towards long on for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Ross Taylor stands tall and guides it to third man for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, dabbed past backward point for a single. 150 up for New Zealand.
Angling into the hips, Ross Taylor hops a bit and works it through square leg for a single.
Another fuller delivery outside off, Ross Taylor drives it straight back to the bowler. Henriques stretches his right leg out and makes a really fine stop.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Ross digs it out towards wide mid on.
Bowls it around off, Taylor comes forward and turns it towards mid on.
Moises Henriques comes on for a bowl.
Flatter on middle, stops a touch on the batsman, Williamson is surprised as he defends it towards the leg side.
Williamson comes down the track and hence Head fires it outside off. Williamson ends up patting it back to the bowler.
Fuller on middle, Williamson defends it watchfully.
Lands it outside off, Williamson dabs it towards short third man. Hastings was a bit lazy to bend and stop it and allows the second.
Bowls it on the stumps, Williamson makes room  to drive but hits it towards extra cover.
It is drizzling again. The umpires have decided to continue.
Fuller on middle, Taylor comes down and clips it through mid on for a single.
Slants it on a good length, Williamson gets outside the line and tucks it through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Interesting point by Simon Doull. They are not giving Williamson any room to dab nor allowing him to work everything on the leg side for a quick single.
Angles it on a good length, Williamson plays close to his body and looks to take a quick single but is sent back.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Williamson ducks under it and lets it go over him.
Fuller outside off, Williamson looks to clip at first but then defends it towards mid on.
Taylor gets across and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Nicely done! Shorter outside off, Taylor cuts it nicely behind point. The third man fielder, Cummins puts in a desperate dive after going to his right but cannot stop the ball. The runs keep flowing.
Fuller one on off, Taylor gets down to long on for a single.
Lands it outside leg, Kane turns it towards long leg for a single.
Flatter on the pads, Williamson turns it towards square leg from his crease.
Gets down and sweeps it to long leg for a single.
Taylor gets forward and turns it towards the leg side.
Floats it around off, turned through mid on for a single.
Travis Head introduced into the attack. Interesting call from Smith. These two should counter the off spinner without much fuss. Let's see how he goes. Maybe looking to fill in some overs?
Shorter in length outside off, Taylor looks to dab it through to third man but fails to connect. This one bounced more on him and hence he could not connect.
Fuller length ball outside off, Taylor comes forward and defends it.
Lands it outside off on a good length, Taylor defends it watchfully.
Bowls it outside off on a length, Taylor looks to cut it through but misses. He has played and missed a few here.
Hurls it outside off, Taylor comes forward and defends it.
Angles it on a good length outside off, Williamson turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Josh Hazlewood returns for a spell.
Nice bowling! Hurls it outside off on a length, Taylor comes forward to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Good comeback by the bowler.
WIDE! Slings this down the leg side on a fuller length. Taylor lets it go and Wade has to dive to his left to stop it. Starc does not look himself here. Struggling for some rhythm.
FOUR! This is top batting from the Kiwis! Short and wide outside off, Taylor this time goes even harder and gets it over the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Taylor looks to cut it through but finds the fielder at point.
Too full on the pads, Williamson clips it towards mid on and takes off for a single. There is a shy at the bowler's end by the substitute but no harm done.
Slants it on a length, Williamson defends it watchfully.
Fuller outside off, Taylor drives it hard through cover-point for a single.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it fuller outside off, Taylor comes forward and drives it through covers for a single.
Outside off on a length, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Shorter outside off, Williamson mistimes his cut towards point.
Edged! Outside off on a length, Taylor flashes it down to third man for a single.
Angles it on a fuller length but just around off, Taylor gets across and defends it to the right of the bowler.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Fuller outside off, Taylor comes forward and drives it through extra cover for a majestic boundary. That was hit superbly by the batsman.
A tad short on the body, Taylor turns it through mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Angles it on a length, Taylor looks to dab it through but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Outside off on a length, Ross defends it watchfully.
Angled across the batsman, on a length, Taylor lets it go through.
Slants it on a good length, Taylor defends it.
Back of a length outside off, punched through covers for a single. That was hit on the up.
Mitchell Starc called back on for a bowl.
Good length outside off, Taylor looks to cut it hard but fails to make contact.
Fuller outside off, Taylor gets across and defends it off the inner half.
Ross Taylor makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! End of Ronchi fireworks for today! Hastings goes wide of the crease and angles it outside off on a length, Ronchi looks to go hard but does not keep it down. Glenn Maxwell at point takes the catch and pumps his fists in joy. His second catch of the day. The drop has not cost Australia much. Hastings strikes and Ronchi would feel he should have done better. But that is the way he plays the game. The Kiwis have dropped Tom Latham for him.
Slower length ball outside off, Williamson again dabs it to third man for a run. Easy as you like.
Angles it on a length on off, Ronchi pushes it through point for a single.
Lands it outside off on a fuller length, Williamson dabs it to third man for a single.

SIX! Ronchi is not stopping here! Length ball from Cummins, Ronchi gets under it and just lofts it over long off for a maximum. This is a serious assault from Luke. 15 runs from the over, with that drop. Cummins has forgettable figures right now. 5-0-52-0!
FOUR! Adding insult to injury! Shorter in length around off, Ronchi looks to give himself room and plays a tennis forehand over mid on for a boundary.
Dropped! Shorter in length outside off, Ronchi looks to drag it through mid-wicket but mistimes it. Starc goes to his right from mid on but does not hold onto it. That should have been taken.
FOUR! Smashed! Cummins bowls it on the stumps, Williamson makes room and crashes it through extra cover for a boundary. He is playing a gem of a knock here.
Shorter length outside off, Ronchi ducks under it and lets it go.

Leg bye! Fuller on the stumps, Williamson looks to clip but gets it off his pads towards fine leg for a single. A stifled appeal is turned down as it was surely going down leg. 100 up for New Zealand.
Sprays it wide outside off on a length, asking for a drive, Ronchi obliges but cannot put bat to ball.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it on the stumps, Ronchi stays back and defends it.
Wide outside off on a length, Ronchi mistimes his cut back down the wicket.
4th ODI fifty for Luke Ronchi!

FOUR! Played Ronchi! Length ball outside off, Ronchi looks to drive but gets an outside edge. The ball flies down to third man for a boundary. He brings up his fifty, he will want to make it a big one.
Fuller one, slower in pace, Ronchi is early into his drive and is beaten all ends up.
Edged! Outside off on a length, Williamson throws his bat at it. He gets an outside edge which flies down to third man for a single.
Tucks this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length on off, worked towards mid on for a single by Ronchi.
50-run stand between Luke Ronchi and Kane Williamson!
FOUR! Almost a stunner! Shorter in length outside off, Ronchi moves across to hook it. The ball goes off the gloves down to the fine leg fence. Wade dived to his left but could not stop the ball.
SIX! What a hit! Cummins angles it on the stumps, Ronchi makes room and just flays it over backward point for a maximum. There was a fielder in the deep but the ball sailed over his head.
A tad short outside off, glided to third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven nicely to mid off by Williamson.
Excellent work! Good length outside off, Ronchi looks to punch it through covers. Henriques though at short extra cover dives to his left and makes a terrific stop.
Slants it on the stumps, Williamson clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Ronchi slaps this length ball outside off, down to long off for a single.

FOUR! More runs for Ronchi. Angles it on the stumps, Ronchi works it off his pads through backward square leg. Starc hares after it and looks to stop the ball near the ropes. Fails to do so and a boundary results.
Mid off drops back.
Worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it outside off, Williamson defends it watchfully.
Good stop, Wade! Slants one on middle and leg, Ronchi looks to pull but gets it off his gloves. The ball rolls to the left of the keeper who dives and stops it from going through.
Back of a length outside off, pushed towards point by the batsman.
FOUR! Neatly done! Angles it on the stumps, on a fuller length, Ronchi just lofts it over the mid on region for a boundary. That was hit as straight as an arrow.
Shorter in length outside off, Ronchi ducks under it.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
A tad short on middle, tucked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Pat Cummins to bowl from the other end. There are covers placed near the sightscreen and the batsman wants it to be displaced.
A touch fuller this time, Ronchi angles it towards point and takes a single.
A tad short outside off, Ronchi stays back and defends it towards point.
Bowls a fuller length ball outside off, Ronchi looks to drive from his crease but is beaten.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. A maximum of four fielders are now allowed outside the circle till the end of 37th over.
The players are making their way out in the middle. Luke Ronchi and Kane Williamson will resume the batting for New Zealand while John Hastings will continue with the ball.
Updated rules - 1 bowler can bowl 10 overs. 4 bowlers can bowl 9 overs. Powerplay 1 (1-9), Powerplay 2 (10-37), Powerplay 3 (38-46). Australia's target will be adjusted by DLS method.

1252 local time - GOOD NEWS! The rains have spared us for now. The covers are being taken off. The game will resume at 1310 local time. It will be a 46-OVERS-per-side-game. The innings break has been reduced to 30 minutes.
1215 local time - The rains have not relented. We will have the next update at 1315 local time. The wait prolongs....
1117 local time - BAD NEWS FOLKS! The umpires have asked the players to leave due to the rain. We can just hope that it is a passing shower and we get a full game.
Ronchi stays back and defends it watchfully.
A little drizzle is visible out there. The groundsmen are getting ready with the covers.
Turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, Williamson looks to defend but is beaten all ends up.
John Hastings is introduced into the attack.

NOT OUT! What happened there? Cummins bowls it on a length on off, Williamson works it towards mid-wicket. He takes off for the single but spots that Ronchi is not responding and then looks to turn around. He slips in the process and his partner now decides to go for the run. Starc comes in from mid on and looks to underarm the throw at the striker's end but fails to hit the stumps. Wade has to dive to collect it and disturbs the stumps with his body. It is referred upstairs. Replays confirm that Wade did have the ball in his hand as he disturbed the stumps with his shoulder but Luke had made it in by that time. Ronchi had given up at first but still went for the run and that was what saved him. What a reprieve!
The umpire has gone upstairs to check for a run out appeal against Ronchi. There's a huge mix-up there.
Angles it on a good length, Williamson defends it watchfully.
Short ball outside off, Williamson rides the bounce and keeps it down.
Back of a length outside off, Williamson punches it towards covers.
Slants it around off, Ronchi gets it through mid-wicket off the inside half for a single.

SIX! Hit on the up! Cummins comes in and angles a good length delivery on the stumps, Ronchi backs away and gives himself some room and lofts it over extra cover for a biggie. Sharp catch in the crowd as well.
FOUR! Short and on the body, Williamson gets under it and pulls it hard through square leg for a boundary. That was hit with a lot of disdain.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Kane.
Slants it on the stumps, worked through wide mid on for a couple of runs. Head was the fielder who gave the ball a chase from mid on.
Angles it on a length on off, Williamson gets across and defends it towards the leg side.
Fuller outside off, Williamson drives it towards point from his crease.
Good length outside off, Williamson defends it watchfully.
Short outside off, Ronchi mistimes his cut towards mid off as the ball bounced more on him.
FOUR! Chipped! Cummins lands it on a length on the stumps, Ronchi gets under it and picks it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. A typical Ronchi clip that.
Another quick single as Williamson taps this one towards mid on for a single.
Angles it on a good length, Williamson gets across and tucks it off the inside edge through backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Hurls it outside off on a length, left alone.
FOUR! Risky! Fuller outside off, Williamson drives it square of the wicket through point for a boundary. He opened the face of the bat in time to get the placement right.
Pat Cummins is called into the attack.
Back of a length on off, Williamson tucks it towards mid-wicket for a quick single. He gets off the mark. A good over for Australia comes to an end.
Angles it on a length on off, Williamson gets in line and defends it watchfully.
Kane Williamson walks out to bat.

OUT! Hazlewood strikes! Angles it on a good length on the stumps, Guptill looks to clip it through the leg side but gets a leading edge towards Maxwell at backward point. Glenn makes no mistake and that is a big wicket for the Australians. Martin is disappointed as he walks back to the pavilion.
Good length on off, guided down to third man for a single.
Short and angling on the body, Ronchi comes down looking to hit it over the infield on the off side but misses it altogether.
Good length on off, Guptill works it wide of mid on for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushed to covers for a single.

FOUR! Well timed! Starc bowls it full and around off, Guptill just presses forward and pushes it down the ground through mid off for a boundary. When you can hit such shots, you don't need to play the high risk shots.
Length ball outside off, Guptill drives it hard but finds the fielder at covers.
Fuller and angling on the stumps, clipped towards mid on by the batsman.
FOUR! Glorious! Fuller outside off, Guptill just leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Full toss outside off, Guptill just hits it to the short extra cover fielder. Should have hit that to the fence.
FOUR! Just over! Fuller outside off, Ronchi just lofts it over a leaping mid off fielder for a boundary. Had there been a taller fielder there, would have been a wicket.
Fullish on middle and leg, pushed towards mid on by the batsman for a single.
BEATEN! Angles it on a length on off, Guptill looks to go over the infield but is beaten all ends up. He needs to be a touch careful, attempting such shots.
Outside off on a length, left alone by Guptill.

FOUR! Nice timing! Brings this one into the batsman from outside off, Guptill pushes it back down the wicket. The timing is good as Warner rushes after it from mid off. He dives and almost stops the ball but ends up taking it with him over the ropes. A boundary results.
On a length outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Bouncer! Short ball on the stumps, Guptill ducks under it.

Woah! Fuller outside off, driven to mid off by Ronchi. David Warner scores a direct hit and appeals. The ball ricochets wide of mid on but they do not go for the extra. Warner wants it to be referred but the umpire Richard Kettleborough is sure that Ronchi is not out. Replays confirm the same. What a decision, brilliant work.
Full toss outside off, Ronchi looks to guide it away but fails to get his bat down in time.
FOUR! In the gap! Full and outside off, Ronchi gets under it and looks to go over the off side. He gets it between point and cover-point for a boundary. That wasn't far away from the fielder.
Slants it across on a good length, Ronchi looks to put it away but fails to connect.
Fuller outside off, Ronchi drives it off the back foot towards mid off.
FOUR! Crashed! A fuller length delivery outside off, Guptill throws his bat at it and gets it past cover-point for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Sprayed wide outside off, Martin goes after it but cannot connect. Josh was looking for some swing there.
Good carry! Hazlewood bowls it outside off on a length, Guptill lets it go. The ball bounces more and goes through at a nice height to Wade.
FOUR! Up and over! Too full and on the pads, Guptill won't miss out and clips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. No batsman will miss out on such balls.
Hurls it outside off on a fuller length, left alone.
WIDE! Sprays it wide outside off, left alone by Guptill. Wide signaled.
Fuller outside off, Ronchi drives it towards third man for a single. That actually went off the outer half.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Two slips for him as well. It has gone a bit dark out there.
A tad short, going across Guptill, left alone. A tight over from Starc.
Too full around off, Ronchi taps it towards covers and takes off. Guptill is a touch slow to respond but so is the fielder Henriques. A single is completed.
On a good length around off, Ronchi stays back and defends it watchfully.
First runs of the day! Fuller on middle and leg, Guptill clips it through mid-wicket. Two fielders hare after it, Head gets to it and returns the ball. Three runs taken.
Slants across a good length delivery outside off, Guptill lets it go.
Fuller one to begin with, on off, Guptill is watchful as he defends it towards mid off.
Game time! The two New Zealand openers are Luke Ronchi and Martin Guptill. Australia begin with Mitchell Starc. He has two slips in place. Here we go...
The players are making their way out in the middle for their respective national anthems.
Australia XI - David Warner, Aaron Finch, Steven Smith(c), Travis Head, Glenn Maxwell, Moises Henriques, Matthew Wade(wk), Mitchell Starc, Pat Cummins, John Hastings, Josh Hazlewood.
New Zealand XI - Martin Guptill, Luke Ronchi(wk), Kane Williamson(c), Ross Taylor, Neil Broom, James Neesham, Corey Anderson, Mitchell Santner, Adam Milne, Tim Southee, Trent Boult.

Australia skipper, Steven Smith informs that Marcus Stoinis, Adam Zampa, James Pattinson and Chris Lynn are the ones who are not playing today. Mentions that they would have bowled first anyway. Reckons that the boys are in a good headspace and they are enjoying themselves in the nets. Feels that the Champions Trophy is a big tournament and they need to start well against a strong New Zealand side.

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson informs that they will bat. Calls it a good surface as always. Says that they have had a break and then the tri-series helped. Tom Latham, Jeetan Patel, Mitchell McClenaghan and Colin de Grandhomme are missing out today. Adds that the short boundaries make the game interesting. Feels that the warm-up games were good and they are looking forward to the contest. Mentions that Australia are a tough side to beat.
TOSS - NEW ZEALAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT.

Australia on the other hand are playing an ODI after a long break. They too, like their neighbours won their warm-up game against Sri Lanka. The other against Pakistan was washed out. There have been many off-field issues which have bothered them but the skipper Steven Smith will hope that the team puts them behind and focus on the task on hand. They have won in all four encounters against the Black Caps in Champions Trophy. Will the history repeat itself or will the Kiwis break the record? Stay tuned with us to find out.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of Match 2 of the ICC Champions Trophy between Australia and New Zealand at Edgbaston. The Kiwis are coming into the tournament on the back of impressive performances in the tri-series involving Ireland and Bangladesh but will be aware that the Aussies will be a different challenge. They played a couple of warm-up games, they lost heavily to India but chased down a score in excess of 350 against Sri Lanka with ease to regain confidence.
